items.source: Alias for the objectName() attribute, for simple default usage.
items.translation: ``objectName()` 属性的别名，用于简单的默认用法。

items.source: Note: This annotation is marked as inherited, allowing for generic management-aware base classes. In such a scenario, it is recommended to not specify an object name value since this would lead to naming collisions in case of multiple subclasses getting registered.
items.translation: 注意：此注解被标记为继承，以支持通用的管理感知基类。在此类场景中，建议不要指定对象名称值，因为如果注册了多个子类，这会导致命名冲突。

items.source: Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
